Oneliner

The satellite is an iSIM-SAT 16U-CubeSat, equipped with an iSIM-90 camera onboard.
Description

Second iSIM-SAT 16 CubeSat.
Results

GEISAT is celebrating 2 years in orbit, and we take the chance to share with you some key facts achieved so far:

  • 11+ million Earth images
  • 166+ Terabytes of downloaded images
  • 11,095 orbits (which is over 3x the distance to the Sun)
  • 3,000+ targeted acquisitions
  • Our first satellite with 5-band SWIR
Notes

Their first satellite Urdaneta seems to use NanoAvionics hardware as per photos but unsure about the second satellite.
